description: This Kotlin source file defines the SecurePrefs class responsible for managing application preferences and secure data storage in an Android app, including encrypted SharedPreferences handling, encoding/decoding JSON data, and exposing reactive state flows for preferences.

classes.name: SecurePrefs
classes.description: A class for managing secure and regular shared preferences with reactive state flows, supporting encryption, JSON encoding/decoding, and preference migration.

methods.name: setLastDiscoveredStableId
methods.description: Updates the last discovered stable ID in preferences.

methods.name: setManualTls
methods.description: Sets whether to use TLS for manual gateway.

methods.name: setGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Stores the gateway bootstrap token securely.

methods.name: setCanvasDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables canvas debug status.

methods.name: getNotificationForwardingPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the notification forwarding policy based on preferences.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingPackages
methods.description: Updates the set of notification forwarding packages.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours
methods.description: Configures quiet hours for notification forwarding.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMaxEventsPerMinute
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of forwarded notification events per minute.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the session key for notification forwarding.

methods.name: loadGatewayToken
methods.description: Loads the gateway token from secure preferences, or from stored tokens.

methods.name: loadGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Retrieves the bootstrap token, loading from preferences or stored state.

methods.name: loadGatewayTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Retrieves TLS fingerprint for a given stable ID.

methods.name: saveGatewayTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Stores TLS fingerprint for a given stable ID.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from secure preferences.

methods.name: putString
methods.description: Stores a string value in secure preferences.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key from secure preferences.
